rationale: The ledger reads reference since v2, as the confirmed decision records, and the schema still serves refund_ref as a deprecated alias, so a consumer that reads either field keeps working. The compatibility claim does not hold at head, and the superseded memory that required refund_ref no longer applies. A consumer that breaks on the alias removal would change this.
